categories.title: Clubs & Epic Derbies
categories.description: Historical rivalries, iconic clubs, trophies, and legendary clashes

questions.question: Which historic fixture is traditionally known as the 'Main Moscow Derby'?
options: Zenit St. Petersburg vs Dynamo Moscow
questions.explanation: The battle between Spartak Moscow and CSKA Moscow is the most fierce and historic Moscow derby.

questions.question: Which club from Saint Petersburg has dominated modern championships with consecutive titles?
questions.explanation: Zenit Saint Petersburg established a dominant championship streak in the modern era.

questions.question: What is the nickname traditionally given to CSKA Moscow due to its historic military sporting club roots?
questions.explanation: CSKA was founded as a military sports society, earning them the nickname 'The Armymen'.

questions.question: Which southern club, founded in 2008, quickly rose to the top flight with a renowned youth academy?
questions.explanation: FC Krasnodar was founded in 2008 and is acclaimed for its state-of-the-art academy and stadium.

questions.question: Which club is known as 'The Railwaymen' due to its founding historical affiliation with the Ministry of Railways?
questions.explanation: Lokomotiv Moscow originated in 1922 under the railroad workers' union.

questions.question: Which club broke the capital's monopoly by winning back-to-back league championships in 2008 and 2009?
questions.explanation: Under manager Kurban Berdyev, Rubin Kazan won consecutive league titles in 2008 and 2009.

categories.title: Legends & Record Breakers
categories.description: Top goalscorers, legendary goalkeepers, clean sheets, and star transfers

questions.question: Which legendary goalkeeper has made over 500 appearances for CSKA and holds the league clean sheets record?
questions.explanation: Igor Akinfeev is the undisputed record holder for most clean sheets in Russian league history.

questions.question: Who holds the record for the all-time highest goal tally in Russian football top flight history?
questions.explanation: Artem Dzyuba holds the all-time goalscoring milestone in Russian Premier League history.

questions.question: Which prolific Brazilian striker formed an iconic attacking partnership at CSKA Moscow winning the 2005 UEFA Cup?
questions.explanation: Vágner Love scored pivotal goals for CSKA during their golden European and domestic campaigns.

questions.question: Which powerhouse Brazilian winger terrorized defences with thunderous long-range strikes for Zenit?
questions.explanation: Hulk was famous for his unstoppable left-footed strikes and explosive physical play.

questions.question: Which Dutch international winger became a fan idol and title winner leading Spartak Moscow's frontline?
questions.explanation: Quincy Promes scored crucial goals to guide Spartak Moscow to the 2016-17 championship.

categories.title: Stadiums & Match Arenas
categories.description: Cutting-edge arenas, host cities, architectures, and matchday atmospheres

questions.question: Which ultramodern stadium in Saint Petersburg features a retractable roof and sliding pitch?
questions.explanation: Gazprom Arena on Krestovsky Island features a retractable roof allowing all-weather football.

questions.question: Which stadium is famous for its panoramic 360-degree LED screen encircling the entire interior bowl?
questions.explanation: Krasnodar Stadium boasts a world-famous 360-degree curved LED video ribbon along the upper tier.

questions.question: What is the home arena of Spartak Moscow located in the Tushino district of Moscow?
questions.explanation: Lukoil Arena (opened as Otkritie Arena in 2014) is Spartak Moscow's modern home fortress.

questions.question: Which historic Moscow venue is unique for housing both a football stadium and an indoor hockey arena under one roof?
questions.explanation: VTB Arena is an innovative dual-venue complex housing both football and basketball/ice hockey.

categories.title: Tactics, VAR & League Rules
categories.description: Match regulations, substitutions, VAR protocols, and championship tie-breakers

questions.question: How many teams compete in the standard Russian Premier League championship table each season?
questions.explanation: The Russian Premier League format features 16 teams playing home and away (30 matchdays).

questions.question: Under standard league regulations, how many player substitutions are allowed per team across 3 stoppage windows?
questions.explanation: Teams are permitted up to 5 substitutions in 3 stoppage intervals (excluding half-time).

questions.question: In the event of a tie in points at the end of the season, what is the first tie-breaker used in the league table?
questions.explanation: Head-to-head results between the tied teams serve as the primary tie-breaking criterion.

questions.question: What is the minimum distance required for defensive wall players from a direct free-kick?
questions.explanation: Defenders must maintain a distance of at least 9.15 meters (10 yards) from the ball.
